༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed tshe bdag nag po la rtags kyi sgo nas bstod pa gshin rje 'joms byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed tshe bdag nag po la rtags kyi sgo nas bstod pa gshin rje 'joms byed ces bya ba bzhugs so//

rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta kā ya liṅga dwa ra stu ti kaḥghīn+na phe nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la rtags kyi sgo nas bstod pa gshin rje 'joms byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal gshin rje rdo rje khro bo chen po la phyag 'tshal lo| |e/ 'das dus 'phags pa klu yi rigs mchog ces// ma 'ongs dus na mgon po kun tu gzigs// da lta sangs rgyas mos pa rab dga' ba'i| |snying po nor bu rin chen brtsegs rgyal po// thub pa'i bstan la 'phags mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs// rgyal kun mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus khyod phyag 'tshal// rtsod dus 'gro rnams dug lnga stobs 'bar bas// zhi bas mi thul de phyir snying rje yi// ngang las sna tshogs khro bo drag po'i sku// rab sprul gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal bstod// don zab sngags kyis stong par sbyangs pa yi// chos kun gdod nas yod ma myong ba'i rtags// kun khyab snying rje mkha' ltar khyab pa ni// mtha' yas 'gro ba bdag tu bzung ba'i rtags// rig pa'i rang rtsal hūm̐ yig 'bar ba ni// kun rdzob 'khrul ngor med bzhin snang ba'i rtags// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsregs gtor sbyangs pa ni// rang sems ye nas 'od gsal dag pa'i rtags// nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor ni// 'byung lnga yum lnga'i dbyings su dag pa'i rtags// byang chen pū ri 'od du 'bar ba ni// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i rtags// gser gyi rgya gram rdo rje'i zer 'phro ba// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das mthu stobs rtags// shel dkar rdo rje'i lte bar bzhugs pa ni// 'gyur med don dam bden pa rdzogs pa'i rtags// gshin rje dregs byed pho mo bsnol ba ni// bdud bzhi'i dmag dpung rtsad nas gcod pa'i rtags// ma he chu glang rgyan ldan bsgyings pa ni// stong gsum dregs pa'i srog snying 'phrog pa'i rtags// sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab stong brdal ba ni// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las 'das pa'i rtags// nyi zla 'od 'bar gdan la bzhengs pa ni// mkha' mnyam 'gro blo'i rmongs mun sel ba'i rtags// de steng hūm̐ nag 'bar zhing 'phro ba ni// rgyu las 'bras 'byung rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtags// de las khro bo'i rdo rje rab 'bar ba// rgyal kun thugs kyi ye shes rdzogs pa'i rtags// de yi lte bar hūm̐ mthing ye shes lnga// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang dbang thob pa'i rtags// yongs gyur sngags kyis rab bskul sku rdzogs pa// rgyal ba kun gyi phyag rgya rdzogs pa'i rtags// sku mdog mthing nag mun chen du ba'i mdog

/chos nyid don la 'gyur ba med pa'i rtags// dbu gsum rab brjid khro rngam 'bar ba ni// skyabs gsum ngo bor don gyis bzhugs pa'i rtags// phyag drug bar snang dbyings su gdengs pa ni// pha rol phyin drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtags// zhabs bzhi gar stabs bsgyings tshul bzhengs pa ni// bsdu tshad rnam bzhis 'gro kun 'dren pa'i rtags// yan lag bcu gsum 'jigs su rung ba ni// sa mchog bcu gsum gdod nas thob pa'i rtags// nying lag lnga bcu tshang bar bstan pa ni// stobs dbang shes lam dbang bcu rdzogs pa'i rtags// g.yas zhal dkar po bzhad cing 'dzum pa ni// gang 'dul thabs kyis sprul skur ston pa'i rtags| |g.yon dmar gshe zhing brtse chags brjid pa ni// longs sku nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i rtags// dbus mthing rngam bgrad dgu dang ldan pa ni// chos sku spros pa'i mtha' kun spangs pa'i rtags// spyan dgu sdang mig 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa ni// theg pa rim dgu'i rtse mor phyin pa'i rtags// snyan gong sbrul nag re res brgyan pa ni// ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs kun 'joms pa'i rtags// khro gnyer dpral ba'i dbyings su bsdus pa ni// 'khor 'das mnyam nyid dbyings su rdzogs pa'i rtags// shangs gnyer zhal gdangs ljags 'gyur sgril ba ni| |snying rje'i ngang nas drag por khros pa'i rtags// rno dbal mche ba bcu gnyis gtsigs pa ni// rten 'brel bcu gnyis srid rtsa gcod pa'i rtags// ā ra li yi sgra chen sgrog pa ni// theg gsum drang nges chos 'khor bskor ba'i rtags// smin ma sma ra dmar ser 'khyug pa ni// mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtags// dbu skra kham nag srid rtser 'phyo ba ni// srid gsum zil gnon stong gsum dbang sdud rtags// phyag g.yas dang pos 'khor lo bsnams pa ni// srid pa'i 'khor lo rtsad nas gcod pa'i rtags// bar pas ral gri 'od 'bar gdengs pa ni// nyon mongs dgra bgegs drag po sgrol ba'i rtags// tha mas rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams pa ni// dug gsum nyes tshogs thal bar rlog pa'i rtags// phyag g.yon dang pos lcags kyu thogs pa ni// 'gro kun 'khor ba'i gnas nas 'dren pa'i rtags// bar pas gtun shing bkan nas 'dzin pa ni// bar gcod bdud tshogs dbang sdud tshar gcod rtags// tha ma sdigs mdzub me dpung 'bar ba ni// ma rig tshang tshing nags tshal sreg pa'i rtags// g.yas kyi zhabs gnyis cung zad bskum pa ni// rga dang na ba'i sdug bsngal spangs pa'i rtags// g.yon gyi zhabs gnyis bgrad cing 'gying ba ni// skye shi'i 'khrul 'khor rtsad nas gcod pa'i rtags// thod skam lnga lngar rigs lnga bzhugs pa ni// rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gtsor gyur pa'i rtags// spyi gtsug khyung nag 'bar ba lding ba ni// gza' klu sa rgyal the'u rang bran 'khol rtags// ba spu khyung dang rdo rjes gtams pa ni// sra brtan rdo rje'i go dang ldan pa'i rtags// thod skam nyer gcig mgur chu byas pa ni// 'jig tshogs lta ngan nyi shu bcom pa'i rtags// thod rlon lnga bcus do shal byas pa ni// 'du byed lnga bcu gnas su dag pa'i rtags// sku stod gnyis 'thung bla gos mnabs pa ni// gti mug chos kyi dbyings su dag pa'i rtags// sku sked zhing gi g.yang gzhi bcings pa ni// 'dod chags sor rtog ngang du dag pa'i rtags// sku smad stag lpags thang gos dkris pa ni// zhe sdang me long ngo bor dag pa'i rtags// yan lag klu chen rigs lngas dkris pa ni// nga rgyal mnyam pa nyid du dag pa'i rtags// lto 'phye nag po mchod phyir thogs pa ni// phrag dog bya grub ngo bor dag pa'i rtags// dur khrod thal ba'i tshom bus btab pa ni// 'du byed phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtags// mchog chen rak+ta'i thig les spras pa ni// dug gsum gsal stong zung 'jug dag pa'i rtags// baṃ chen zhag gi zo ris byas pa ni// 'gro ba'i don rnams thabs kyis mdzad pa'i rtags// sku las sprul pa'i pho nya spro ba ni// phrin las lhun grub rgyun chad med pa'i rtags// las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni// phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyings su gcig pa'i rtags// ye shes me dpung bskal me ltar 'bar ba// rmongs pa'i 'khrul pa rtsad nas sreg pa'i rtags// rnam mang rin chen du mas brgyan pa ni// 'dod yon ma spangs rgyan du che ba'i rtags// sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan 'phur ba ni// ma lus yon tan dbyings su rdzogs pa'i rtags// thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi 'bar ba ni// phrin las bzhi sgrub dngos grub stsol ba'i rtags// rtsibs steng 'jam dpal gzhon nu bzhugs pa ni// ye shes sems dpa' zhi bar bzhugs pa'i rtags// de dbus rin chen las grub mchod rten ni// chos dbyings mnyam yangs mtha' bral ston pa'i rtags// bum nang rdo rje rigs lnga yab yum bcus// dam pa rigs brgya don gyis rdzogs pa'i rtags// lte bar bh+rūṃ nang hūm̐ yig 'od lnga 'bar// ting 'dzin mi g.yo ye shes ldan pa'i rtags// bsrung ba'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba ni// gzhom med nā da rlung sngags dbyer med rtags// g.yon du sbyor yum ma mo bzhugs pa ni// thabs dang shes rab 'du 'bral med pa'i rtags// g.yas su sras mchog 'bar ba khro tshul ni// bde stong sgyu 'phrul gar gyis dpa' ba'i rtags// mdun du 'chi bdag lcags chas bsgyings ba ni// 'chi bdag bdud tshogs phye mar brlag pa'i rtags// rgyab tu srog bdag gdengs ka g.yo ba ni// srog dbugs dbang byed ma lus 'dul ba'i rtags// bsrung ba'i khro bo khro mo bzhugs pa ni// sngags 'chang mi mthun g.yul las rgyal ba'i rtags// bsrung ba'i gur khang bcu gsum sra btsan ni// gnas skabs mthar thug 'gal rkyen srung ba'i rtags// phyi nang gsang mchod mkho dgur ldan pa ni// gang 'dod 'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa'i rtags// lus lha ngag sngags sems nyid 'od gsal ba// don gnyis lhun grub 'bras bu thob pa'i rtags// 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i tshogs// rang rig ka dag chen po'i rang mdangs las// sna tshogs du mar shar zhing 'gag med rtsal| |gzhan du mi rtog sngags 'chang rig pa'i mdangs// gang 'dul der snang sgyu ma'i lha tshogs la// gnyis med gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag bgyi zhing*// phyi nang gsang ba sman raka gtor mar bcas// gus pas 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes nas kyang*// thugs kyi dam skong nyams bshags tshangs par stsol// phrin las rnam bzhi myur du grub par mdzod// bdag dang mkha' mnyam mtha' yas sems can rnams// deng nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// bcom ldan khyod kyis dge ba'i bshes mdzod la// don gnyis lhun grub sangs rgyas thob par shog

|de ma thob kyi tshe rabs thams cad du// dal 'byor mchog thob chos ldan grogs dang phrad// dam pas rjes 'dzin sngags kyi theg par 'jug /smin lam dbang gis rgyud sbyangs snod du rung*// grol lam bskyed rdzogs gdams pa rab bsgom zhing*// dngos grub rtsa ba rdo rje slob dpon mchog /mnyes shing thugs sun mi dbyung dam mi 'dral// rtsa ba yan lag srung mtshams mthar dbyung zhing*// bzlas brjod drod thob rim gnyis rtsal thob shog /thal phyir tha snyad sgrog gis ma bcings shing*// rtog ge 'khrul pa'i snang bas ma bslad par// nyan rang theg dman lam du mi 'jug cing*// byang sems theg pa'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs te// zab mo sngags kyi rnal 'byor la brtson nas// rang gzhan dam pa'i chos la gzhol gyur cig /khyad par mos ldan theg mchog sngags 'chang bdag /tshe rabs kun tu lhag pa'i lha'i gtso bor// bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed khyod 'dzin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bstan dang rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// grub mchog bdag dang rdo rje'i mched rnams la// log par 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gnod byed rnams// zhi zhing dbang bsdus snying rjes zlog par mdzod// gal te zhi ba'i lam gyis ma thul na// drag pos sgrol la byang chub myur thob mdzod// bdag cag dpon slob mthun pa'i 'khor bcas kyi// nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar gcod zhi ba dang*// tshe dpal longs spyod dpal 'byor bsod nams rgyas// mos bzhis khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdus// bstan gnod phyi nang drag pos sgrol ba dang*// dgyes pa'i zhal ston bsgrubs pa'i rtags phyung zhig /phrin las mngon mdzod bka' dang bstan pa srungs// 'khor sdus nor skyongs dpal dang grags pa sgrubs// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs dpung thul| |bar chad rkyen zlog bsam pa'i don kun sgrubs// bcol ba'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod// ces 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la rtags kyi sgo nas bstod pa gshin rje 'joms byed ces bya ba 'di'ang*/

'bri gung pa skyu ra'i gdung las sngags pa'i cha lugs can rim pa gnyis kyi lam nyams su len pa la le lo che zhing gnyid dang rnam g.yeng gi nor can/ mgo skyes dang lcags phur g.yag ru tsher ma'i phreng ba'i rgyan gyi khur can blo gros kun nas rmongs pa/ don med rnga rdung gis khyim mtshes gnyid dkrog gi las la brtson pa/ chos kyi grags pa zhes bya ba'i ming can bdag gis/ me glang cho 'phrul zla ba'i dkar phyogs la lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub cig bgyis pa'i tshe/ bcos min gyi sems dang ba'i 'dun pa kho nas mtshams sbyar te bstod cing*/ slar 'bri klung dbur stod bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig pad+ma 'od du bris pa'i dge bas/ pha mar gyur pa'i sems can thams cad 'jam dpal dbyangs mgon po kun tu gzigs kyi go 'phang bde blag nyid du thob par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
